name: formatting-marketmaker-documents
description: Format and render formal CRX market-maker documents to the CRX document standard — the Margin and Settlement Overview, Collateral Overview, margin methodologies, rules overviews, mechanism memos, MM-facing one-pagers. Locks one LaTeX-style document class: letterhead serif register, closed component inventory, page geometry, type and color tokens, figure grammar, and a conformance gate that renders HTML to PDF locally.
